My opinion on Dogecoin 🐕

It’s a very high risk investment but even more so than cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin because of its unlimited supply. Basic economics tells us that an unlimited supply will affect the demand and price. I have not invested and I don’t plan on doing so.

Dogecoin has an unlimited supply 🐕

This means that there is no cap on how many Dogecoins can be mined/produced. This is unlike other cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin which has a limit of 21 million. There are currently over 113 billion Dogecoins and that number is still rising.
